spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (कठति)
To live in distress.
(इ) कठि r. 1st and 10th cls. (कण्ठति-ते कण्ठयति)
1 To grieve.
2 To recollect.
With उद् prefixed,
to regret or miss, to lament, to bewail.

m. (-ठः)
1 The name of a Muni or saint.
2 A note or simple sound.
3 A portion of the Yajur

Veda.
4

A Mantra or mystical prayer.
5 A

Brahman.
6
A Brahman versed in the Vedas, especially in the Rig

Veda.
7

A student of the same.
8 Trouble, distress.
f. (-ठी)
The wife of a Brahman.
E.
कठ to be confused, and अप् aff.

m. (-ठः)
A stone, a rock.
E.
कठ to be hard, &c. अण् affix; also with कन् added, काठक.

m. (-र्त्तः)
A BRAHMAN skilled in the Kaṭha branch of the Vedas.
E.
कठ, and धूर्त्त cunning.

m. (-र्द्दः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
कठ distress, मर्द्द who dissipates.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Hard.
E.
कठ trouble, and र from रा to take or give, affix ड.

m. (-यः)
A BRAHMAN who has studied the Kaṭha portion of the Vedas.
E.
कठ, and श्रोत्रिय a BRAHMAN.

m. (-कः)
A teacher of the Kaṭha portion of the Veda.
E.
कठ, and अध्यापक a teacher.

m. (-कः)
A gallinule.

Chalk.
2
The Tulasi.

m. (-रः)
A plant worshipped by the Hindus, commonly Tulsi, (Ocymum sanctum, or sacred basil.)
E.
कठिन hard, and जृ to destroy, affix अच्, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Hard, solid.
2 Unkind, severe.
3 Paralysed, rendered stiff or rigid.
4 Difficult, obscure.
nf. (-नं-ना)
An earthen vessel.
f. (-ना)
A sweetmeat made with refined sugar.
(-नी or निका)
Chalk.
E.
कठ to be confounded, and इनच् Uṇādi affix, fem. affixes टाप् and ङीष्.

m. (-नः)
The date fruit.
n. (-नं)
1

Hardness.
2

Sternness.
E.
कठिन and अण aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Firmness, hardness.
2

Severity.
3

Difficulty, obscurity.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कठिनत्वं.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A tortoise.
E.
कठिन, and पृष्ठ back; also कठिनपृष्ठक.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Hardhearted, cruel, unkind.
E.
कठिन, and हृदय the heart.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Harsh, cruel, severe.
E.
कठिन, and अन्तःकरण disposition.

m. (-ल्लः)
A plant, (Momordica charantia): see कटिल्ल.

m. (-कः)
1 A plant: see the preceding.
2 A name of Tulasi or holy basil.
3 Hogweed.
E.
कन् added to the preceding: see कटिल्ल and कटिल्लक.

m. (-रः)
A needy or distressed man, a pauper.
E.
कठ to be distressed, and एरक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रुः)
The Indian Plutus.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Hard, solid.
2 Severe, cruel.
3 Full, complete, full-grown.
4 Full, (as the moon.)
E.
कठ to be distressed, &c. आरन् Uṇādi affix; also कठोल.

f. (-ता)
1 Hardness, firmness.
2 Severity, rigor.
E.
तल्, added to the preceding; also कठोरत्वं with त्व aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
See कठोर.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
According to the Kaṭha portion of the vedas.
E.
कठ, and वुञ् aff.

Hardness.
2

Difficulty, obscurity.
3 Sternness, severity.
E.
कठिन hard, and ष्यञ् aff.
